Overview
It’s easy to forget that the B7-generation S4 packed a 4.2 litre V8 and, in cabriolet form, it represents a compelling and, these days, lower cost proposition for those seeking open-top motoring with a naturally aspirated V8 soundtrack.
Naturally, being an Audi, the 4.2-litre engine delivers its power through quattro all-wheel drive which makes for an all-year-round usable drop top.
This 2006 example has covered 67,150 miles across three keepers. The current owner acquired it in September 2020 and looks to have kept on top of maintenance, despite covering only limited mileage. In particular, a full refresh of the ignition coils (and spark plugs) and a new exhaust provide some peace of mind for the next owner.
Finished in Dolphin Grey over cream leather, it's a combination that looks sophisticated with the roof up and properly glamorous with it down. In all, it's a great looking and gorgeous sounding convertible that can be enjoyed whatever the weather.

Summary
Here's a V8 you can buy with your head, not just your heart. The heavy lifting has been done. Over £4,000 in recent invoices document exactly what's been addressed: water ingress sorted, oil leaks fixed, ignition refreshed, and that MIJ exhaust fitted. These are the bills the next owner doesn't have to pay.
With the leaks plugged, the electrics waterproofed, and the ignition renewed, this S4 is ready to be driven rather than worried about. Roof down, V8 singing, quattro grip on tap. Sounds like fun to us.
To arrange a viewing, click the 'Book Viewing' button located under the 'Place Bid' button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to 'Contact Seller' for further enquiries. This seller is located in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire.
